description: Follow-up experiments found the link between dendritic activity and detection largely confined to layer 5B neurons that project to subcortical regions, including nonspecific thalamus, while corticocortical layer 5A cells tracked report less closely. Suppressing the subcortical targets of layer 5 neurons suppressed detection (Takahashi et al. 2020, as reported).
limitations: Reported secondhand, in Aru et al. 2019 as a paper under revision and in Storm et al. 2024. The original Nature Neuroscience paper is not read here. Rodents, one laboratory.

sources.quote: the positive relationship between dendritic activity and animal behavior is largely constrained to the pyramidal cells in layer 5B that project to subcortical regions
Suppressing the subcortical targets (particularly higherorder thalamus) of L5 pyramidal neurons suppresses conscious perception.
